entities.summary: Raymond James Hannigan was a Canadian professional ice hockey right winger. He played 3 games for the Toronto Maple Leafs of the National Hockey League during the 1948–49 season. The rest of his career lasted from 1947 to 1955 and was spent in the minor leagues. His brothers, Pat and Gord, also played professional hockey.
